name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based 1-2 frame press and wave release input buffer.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the input buffer on or off.

normal-ticks.name: Normal ticks
normal-ticks.description: Max delay (in ticks) for cube, ball, UFO, spider, robot and swing. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps.

wave-ticks.name: Wave ticks
wave-ticks.description: Max delay (in ticks) while in wave. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps.

spam-guard.name: Spam guard
spam-guard.description: When you click fast (3+ clicks closer than the spam interval) the buffer lets inputs through untouched. Also protects FPS.

spam-interval.name: Spam interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Clicks closer together than this count as spam. 20 ticks = 12 clicks/sec.

background-image.name: Menu background image
background-image.description: Pick a PNG or JPG to use as the background of the Buffer menu. Leave empty for the default look. Tip: use images up to about 1024x1024 so the game does not run out of memory.

background-opacity.name: Background opacity (%)
background-opacity.description: How visible the custom background is.

background-dim.name: Background darkening (%)
background-dim.description: Darkens the custom background so the buttons and text are easier to read.

noclip.name: Noclip (practice mode only)
noclip.description: You do not die from obstacles. Only works while playing in Practice Mode, so it never affects normal runs.

game-speed.name: Game speed (practice mode only)
game-speed.description: Speed of the game, from 0.10x (slow motion) to 2.00x. Only applies in Practice Mode.

auto-close.name: Menu auto-close (seconds)
auto-close.description: Seconds without touching the menu before it closes by itself. 0 = never.

button-corner.name: Pause button corner
button-corner.description: Where the Buffer button appears in the pause menu.

button-scale.name: Pause button size
button-scale.description: Size of the Buffer button in the pause menu.
